name: Busy Bee Cafe
address: 810 Martin Luther King Jr Drive SW
ownershipEvidence: Busy Bee's official history identifies Milton Gates as purchaser and Tracy Gates as owner and leader; Discover Atlanta's authoritative Black-owned-restaurants guide states the cafe is owned by the Gates family, with Tracy Gates at the helm (https://discoveratlanta.com/stories/eat/atlantas-favorite-black-owned-restaurants/).
notes: Official site describes a current Vine City restaurant; official Toast destination independently displays the numbered address and phone. Everyday food use; research-only candidate near Morehouse/AUC.

name: Paschal's
subcategory: soul food restaurant and event space
ownershipEvidence: Atlanta Eats identifies Paschal's as a place where one of America's greatest Black entrepreneurs built wealth, names founders James and Robert Paschal, and says James's son Curtis continues the family tradition at the current Castleberry Hill restaurant (https://www.atlantaeats.com/blog/black-owned-atl-paschals/). The New Georgia Encyclopedia independently documents the Paschal brothers' founding and calls the associated Paschal's Motor Hotel the first Black-owned hotel in Atlanta (https://www.georgiaencyclopedia.org/articles/arts-culture/paschals-restaurant/).
notes: Official site explicitly presents the current restaurant/event space and lists the numbered address and phone. Everyday food use; research-only candidate near Morehouse/AUC.
